title: Houston is big.
old_caption:
They're 45 minutes away. Is that a dealbreaker?
Distance is a plan, not a no. Meet in the middle.

title: The stars are campaigning.
old_caption:
If the stars could land in your city next, where would you pick?
Texas first, then every sign-up counts as a vote.

title: Dear Capricorn: you have a free Friday.
old_caption:
Capricorn, did you just try to schedule your one free Friday?
Leave it empty. Rest counts as a date too.

title: Virgo and Pisces, date #20.
old_caption:
Waiting for love to look perfect?
Date twenty for Virgo and Pisces: a broken mug, two cats, one couch. Not perfect. Theirs.

title: Houston, a check-in.
old_caption:
What have you learned about love this year?
The stars came down to give advice and learned a few things back. One more for the album.

title: Dear Chicago.
old_caption:
Rushing to find someone before winter ends?
Cuffing season isn't a deadline. Find someone you'd want in July too.

title: The ghost has a confession.
old_caption:
Ever been too shy to say hi, even after showing up every time?
The ghost finally speaks up, and the stars already saw it.

title: Dear Corpus Christi: it's windy.
old_caption:
Do your texts start with a long wind-up?
In a windy city, the stars say lead with the important part first.

title: Road trip: Dallas
old_caption:
You want to go out, they need a quiet night in. Who is right?
Leo and Aquarius learn to ask what the other needs.

title: Texas dance hall: two-step night.
old_caption:
Ever been terrible at something on a date and loved it?
Be new at something together. Laughing counts as dancing.
